question: Can marker slots 1-6 and placement be driven by an existing ordinary foreground keyboard, mouse, controller, chat/console, accessibility, or launcher action without camera movement or menu traversal?

input_action_registry.conclusion: The exact registry has generic pointer, UI, chat, and combat actions but no action that selects numbered scene-mask marker slots or initiates FlagSkill for them.

normal_game_ui_route.slot_mapping: scene-mask slots 201-206 map to marker skills 1101-1106
normal_game_ui_route.conclusion: Keyboard/mouse/controller can operate the ordinary UI, but the discovered route requires selecting a marker entry and moving the game-owned targeting reticle. It is not a direct slot trigger and does not accept saved XYZ.

controller_and_accessibility.controller_behavior: The exact types adapt gamepad axes and buttons into a UI pointer. They provide menu traversal, pointer motion, and click behavior; no numbered marker action is present.

chat_and_console.warning: Presence of the generic IngameDebugConsole library is not evidence that its UI is enabled or public in the production client; neither registered command is a marker command.

launcher_and_deep_link.public_source_boundary: The official Steam product surface documents Play Game and product features but no marker action, URI, command-line switch, or launcher automation contract. Absence from one product page is corroborative only, not standalone proof.

candidate_confusions.reason_not_route: It has no world-position argument and no static connection to numbered scene-mask marker slots 201-206 or skills 1101-1106.

candidate_confusions.reason_not_external_action: It is the Lua UI boundary after a marker entry is chosen, not an InputActionIds binding, chat command, launcher hook, or saved-XYZ action.

candidate_confusions.reason_not_route: It is a generic bundled console framework; the exact registered ConsoleMethod attributes contain only scene.loadasync and common.framerate.
The named exact-build API handles token links and has no marker consumer.

limits: A static name and Lua-call census cannot prove the absence of a wholly dynamically generated or server-delivered command that leaves no exact-build artifact.
No runtime keybind enumeration, console activation, input generation, or controller experiment was performed.
The official Steam page is not a complete control manual and is used only as corroborating public-source evidence.
A future seasonal build requires a new registry and Lua census.
